purpose: Fictional portfolio restyling based on supplied Noormeher screens, not live-site screenshots or changes to the live site
sharedPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. The input is an actual software screenshot used only as structural reference. Create a substantially restyled fictional DEMO screenshot with similar pages, layout logic and existing features, but make it clearly visually different from the original. Replace all original logos, institution names, photos, people and identifying text. Fictional demo brand: 'Brightfield Trust' with small 'DEMO'. Consistent new art direction: warm ivory #f8f5ef, deep indigo #292945, muted lavender #b9b2ce, restrained coral #d48c71; refined editorial serif headings with highly legible sans-serif UI, squared soft 8px corners, thin borders, generous spacing and light shadows. No original green/blue styling. Flat straight-on full website/app screenshot, wide aspect ratio, no perspective, device mockups, browser tabs, URL bar, bookmarks or desktop chrome. All photos must be newly generated fictional educational images; never retain or replicate any real person from the input. No actual student identity, names, DOB, parents' details, banking details, scannable QR codes or phone numbers. No fake testimonials or claimed real outcomes. Footer on every output: 'Concept restyling / Fictional imagery / Demo content'. This is a portfolio image, NOT a modification of any live website.

All institution branding Brightfield Trust DEMO.

Label the summary panel 'DEMO CONTENT'.

Admin sign-in screen: preserve the centred split login panel, institution overview, three informational feature areas for Student Records, Attendance & Leave, Gallery & Achievements, and right sign-in form with Username, Password and Sign In. Use a tasteful newly generated illustration of books and an open school courtyard as small decorative art in left panel, not an image of actual people. New refined serif heading 'Welcome to your workspace'. No filled credentials or new authentication features. Crop browser chrome away.

Admin Manage Gallery screen: preserve dark left sidebar, top bar, current-session panel, Manage Gallery header, three summary blocks, Admin Alerts, Add Gallery (Year Wise) form and Manage Gallery (Year Wise) search/list. Keep existing sidebar functions: Dashboard, Admission, Attendance, Student Achievements, View Donations, View Contact, Gallery, Student Reports, Settings, Leave System. Demo summary values '3 Gallery years', '24 Gallery photos', '2025–2026 Latest collection'; alerts '2 demo contact entries' and '1 sample profile missing a photo'. Make clear 'Demo data'. No real student details. Similar functional information architecture, substantially different visual styling.
coverPrompt: Make a portrait 3:4 portfolio gallery cover using the two attached FICTIONAL DEMO UI screenshots. This is a presentation asset, not website code. Preserve their identifiable screen contents and visual identity; do not invent any new UI. Warm ivory background, deep indigo editorial typography, subtle lavender rules and small coral accent. Top heading 'SCHOOL & TRUST' on one line if possible then 'MANAGEMENT'. Small upper label 'WEBSITE + ADMIN PORTAL'. Centre the complete supplied homepage screenshot in a flat clean frame at natural wide aspect ratio. Below it place the supplied admin gallery-management screen in a second flat frame, also at natural wide aspect ratio. No perspective, no physical device, no PROSPERA logo or real institution name, no claims or metrics outside the DEMO screenshot. Bottom caption 'Concept visuals / Fictional imagery / Demo data'. Generous margins, premium restrained spacing. Clearly distinguish this cover as a concept representation of a school management project.
